status: Independent public-model direct-biosphere calculation calibrated; not a complete municipal-disposal conversion approval. Market routing, freight, operating services, engineered treatment proxies and cut-off scrap handovers remain to be qualified.
origin: Recalculated public Doka 2017 workbooks; no licensed source exchange vectors used as model inputs or copied into this resource.

method.mean_rounding: Four significant digits in public export column AI (burning) or BL (landfill).
method.variance_rounding: Round basic lognormal variance to five significant digits, then add the separately documented pedigree variance.
method.flow_identity: Public master-data table, matched by name and complete receiving compartment; do not use numeric zero values from metadata export formulas.

limitations: These data reproduce only direct biosphere exchanges for the nine inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off MSW treatment cases; complete source LCIs or LCIA equivalence are not established.
The public ancillary-exchange table records required loader/diesel inputs and recovered metal outputs; it does not approve their conversion or omission.

Separate wet/dry climate classes, fossil/non-fossil carbon and short-/long-term groundwater compartments are retained; no capture, engineered leachate treatment or avoided virgin-production credit is invented.
Pedigree ratings are the explicitly retained source-quality assumptions, not new measured uncertainty. Cross-exchange correlations are not established.

The original public reports and workbooks are not redistributed; they stay external calculation sources. This resource stores independently generated numerical outputs, citations and calibration evidence.
No runtime mapping, public sector gate, Python transformation module or source Brightway dataset is changed by this calculation evidence.
